settings.label: Websites to check
settings.help: One per line. To also check that a page shows some text, add | and the text. Example: https://www.yourshop.com | Add to cart

settings.label: Failed checks before alerting
settings.help: 2 avoids false alarms from a single slow response.

settings.label: Email for alerts
settings.help: Where urgent alerts are sent. Use an address someone reads every day.

settings.label: Sender name on emails
settings.help: The name people see in their inbox. Example: Sarah from Maison Lina

settings.label: Google Sheet link
settings.help: Create an empty Google Sheet, add the tabs from the guide, then copy the link from your browser's address bar and paste it here.
